completeEntryUnchanged.name: Resonance Seal
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, locking one magical effect in place and preventing dispelling by normal means. Preserve Instantaneous metadata. NEW select one individually perceptible ongoing magical application with a discrete spatial origin/area and actual dispel interface, perceived within range/line of effect, owned by you or explicitly permitted by its actual current source owner/controller. A fixed effect can qualify even if it currently has no movement permission. A permanently creature/carried-object-attached effect is excluded rather than immobilizing its bearer. A class engine, whole creature, permanent item enchantment without a separate eligible ongoing application, completed instantaneous result or nonexistent aura is not a target. No rank cap or resistance roll is added once those real permissions are present.

NEW maintain one nonconcentration Seal for up to seven elapsed days, ending earlier when the protected application ends. Fix that application's spatial origin at its actual current world position. It loses authorized relocation/recentering while sealed, but keeps its actual source-permitted radius/shape evolution and unrelated effects; anchoring is not a frozen event clock or expanded shape permission. The parent's owner, rank, DC, concentration, duration, recipient set, charges, pulses, resource history and ordinary source-ending permissions remain. A one-minute parent still ends after its original minute. The Seal neither maintains another caster's concentration nor prevents their voluntary ending, source destruction, legitimate expiry or an independently specified non-dispel ending.

Normal dispelling cannot end the protected application or this Seal itself while protection operates, including an otherwise eligible Greater Dispel. A source explicitly overriding nondispellable/anchored protection retains only its real written scope; no high-rank automatic bypass is invented. Counterspell can stop the Seal before establishment. Actual suppression is distinct: it suspends the Seal's protection/anchor while the original seven-day clock continues. A separately legal dispel can then affect an otherwise eligible parent or Seal only if it can actually resolve through that suppression environment and its own normal rank/target rules. This creates no permission to cast inside antimagic or assume that a low-rank dispel can remove a rank-six Seal. If a mobile parent moves while the Seal is suppressed, on resumption the Seal fixes its then-current origin, not a backward teleport to the old point; this is a NEW specific resumption rule, with no renewed duration or lost-history reset.

One active Resonance Seal per caster. A genuinely established new Seal replaces that caster's old one, freeing the old parent's movement/ordinary dispel eligibility without ending it. Hidden failure/countering creates no replacement. The caster may end their Seal with an Action while personally perceiving its anchor within60feet and line of effect. Separate other casters' Seals retain their own original deadlines; fixing the same origin supplies no cumulative protection rank or added duration. A genuinely conflicting attempt to establish a second origin for an already immovable effect does not move that effect; its current actual position is the only admissible anchor.

NEW exclude Resonance Seal, Spell Seal and Resonance Anchor themselves from this spell's eligible targets, preventing cross-protection loops among these three families. The earlier Spell Seal proposal remains unadopted and unchanged. This draft proposes no automatic amendment to it: any later reciprocal exclusion requires its own explicit joint disposition. Only Resonance Seal targeting is defined here. Reviewed Resonance Anchor is unchanged and keeps its own normal dispellability. Compared with the distinct proposed Spell Seal, Resonance Seal has actual spatial anchoring, source-owner permission, one active caster slot and a seven-day maximum; Spell Seal proposes broader application targeting and a24-hour nondispel-only benefit. Neither is silently merged or renamed. No body, RP, charge, missed pulse, old effect or frozen lifetime is created by either name.

CURRENT TRANSPORT/CLOCK LIMIT: the target is one eligible spatial magical application, not a body, vehicle, entire plane or generated Banishment cell. Sealing an eligible portal anchor cannot suppress a mandatory independent closure/expiry or preserve its destination beyond the portal source. It cannot keep ordinary Banishment open or stop BAN-CLOSE-03. A later actual suppressor must establish suppression of this Seal before the protection ceases; mere intent, caster entry into an unrelated field, or a purported high-rank dispel does not supply that premise. Suppression does not by itself prove that a dispel can operate in the same location. AC5 Antimagic Field (Lesser) and Greater Dispel are now jointly accepted. Apply AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04: a Greater Dispel operation at an antimagic-suppressed Seal or parent locus is itself suppressed; the target-field self-exemption applies only to an operation targeting that Antimagic field. Snapshot all operations before any removals, with no same-cast rescan. Suppressing Seal therefore does not by itself establish a successful dispel route.

CURRENT EXECUTABLE REMOVAL CONCLUSION: apply AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01. The accepted Lesser Antimagic + Greater Dispel combination does not create a successful selective suppress-then-dispel route for Seal/parent at the same suppressed locus. Wizard class Dispel /cards/19 is a rank3 spell, not a magical nonspell.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Planar Barrier
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. NEW choose a fixed vertical rectangular wall up to30feet wide and15feet high, with1foot thickness, resting on actual ground. Choose its full position/orientation before commitment; every point must be within60feet and caster line of effect at formation. Width and height use whole5foot panels, producing at most18panels. No curved dome, moving wall or physical material is supplied. The initial volume must be free of creature bodies and solid terrain; known conflict fails preflight, a hidden conflict discovered at resolution defeats the whole paid formation. The wall is visible but transparent to ordinary sight/sound and does not itself supply cover.
exactAuthority.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. A mere current visitor is not assigned a native plane. A record that expressly changes/suppresses that classification is honored for its stated duration. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
exactAuthority.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack. CURRENT EXPLICIT VERTICAL-FALL EXCEPTION: apply fallingAndPlacement below when gravity carries a body down through a top/bottom edge; the wall supplies no horizontal supporting face. This exception does not authorize lateral passage through an otherwise operative broad vertical face.
exactAuthority.fallingAndPlacement: Selective wall supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported Falling continues under the ordinary Fall Marker. QUALIFICATION-CHANGE branch: if an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting an otherwise operative fixed5x5 panel, that entire panel is pending until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. This whole-panel rule is for a body becoming qualifying inside an operative panel, not for antimagic clipping. NEW explicit completion for the existing no-platform promise: downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped by this selective wall. If that lawful vertical entry creates actual interior body overlap with a fixed panel, mark the whole intersected panel pending until qualifying bodies clear, exactly as for qualification-change occupancy. Other operative panels still block lateral crossing. A lateral forced movement component toward an operative face stops at its boundary while the independent unsupported vertical fall keeps its original marker/distance history. No support, extra save, impact damage or new Fall Marker is supplied by the wall itself.
exactAuthority.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
exactAuthority.suppressionAndEnding: The nonphysical ongoing rank6 wall has one parent and fixed5x5 panels. LOCAL-SUPPRESSION branch: a suppressor removes only the exact geometric portions it intersects while concentration/deadline continue. At resumption, each previously suppressed clear portion returns; an exact suppressed portion intersecting a qualifying body remains absent until clear. Unsuppressed portions were never removed. This clipped-portion rule is distinct from the qualification-change whole-panel pending rule. Losing actual ground support invalidates dependent panels for the remainder of this cast. One active Planar Barrier per caster. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source removal ends all panels.
exactAuthority.currentPanelPrecision: Fixed5ft panels remain the authored wall cells. For local suppression, preserve exact clipped intersection geometry; do not rectangularize a sphere. For qualification change in an otherwise operative panel, pending applies to the whole5ft panel. Neither branch crushes/ejects, tactically reselects a hole, or refreshes duration. For pending-panel occupancy use actual positive-volume interior overlap. Merely touching a neighboring panel face/edge does not occupy that panel. The one-foot wall thickness participates in spherical clipping; y=0 diagrams are cross-sections only.

exactAuthority.access: KEEP one source identity with two fully distinct printed operations. Current actual class rows grant Divination6/base13/range60 to Cleric11, Wizard11, Mirrorsage16 and Shaman16; they grant Conjuration8/base21/range120 to Druid15 and Mage15. No other mode is granted by a global minimum-rank/header, another school's progression or this proposal. Both retain Action and V/S/F. All original placements, including conflicting global metadata and Core Instantaneous, remain intact as evidence. NEW each mode receives its own explicit finite concentration duration below.
exactAuthority.alignmentAndBonus: At successful resolution snapshot the caster's actually defined effective complete alignment pair after accepted underlying history/overlays. If either axis is genuinely undefined, the paid cast establishes no Nexus and supplies no alignment diagnosis. This pair never changes for that application. A creature benefits only when its actual current complete effective pair matches at the creation of an eligible roll. NEW the Nexus insight benefit is +2 to that creature's actual attack-roll, saving-throw and ability-task modifier, before rolling. It changes no AC, damage, DC, HP, RP, rank, critical range, proficiency, automatic result or fixed opposed total. The source's actual normal resolution and information rules still apply. A reroll/replacement of that same original event retains its original modifier set under its own source, rather than resnapshotting alignment to ratchet a bonus.
exactAuthority.overlapAndIdentity: Both modes share one explicitly NEW family, alignment-nexus.insight. A creature receives at most one+2 from that family at an event, regardless of casts, modes, plane effects or casters; choose the earliest eligible active source for equal applicable benefits. This does not reclassify any unrelated class/item bonus into a new universal stacking family. One active Alignment Nexus per caster across both modes. Beginning either new concentration ends the caster's old concentration under ordinary rules even if the new cast later fails. Other casters retain independent records and clocks.
exactAuthority.readout: Eligibility supplies no public roster, alignment identification, oath permission, compelled choice, belief change or origin inference. Hostile matching creatures can benefit just as allies can. Neither mode rewrites alignment to make a creature qualify. Its own bonus is a local magical expression at the beneficiary; actual local suppression can suspend that expression without changing the underlying alignment record.

currentIntegration.modeAccess: Use only the actual class row: Cleric11/Wizard11 Divination6 13RP 60ft; Mirrorsage16/Shaman16 Divination6 13RP 60ft; Druid15/Mage15 Conjuration8 21RP 120ft. No global header creates a portal placement.
currentIntegration.transportClassification: AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01: Conjuration8 crossings are planar transitions and teleportation for this spell only. This intentionally differs from accepted AC5 Alignment Portal.
currentIntegration.portalBodies: Each live mouth is a fixed physical 10-foot-wide by 15-foot-high aperture with exact pose. Whole-body entry and exit footprints must fit. The portal itself does not create difficult terrain. Actual terrain rate is 1/2/3 movement per foot, then crawling adds +1 per foot and squeezing +1 per foot. Thus 5ft difficult+squeeze costs15ft; difficult+crawl+squeeze costs20ft.
currentIntegration.planeBenefit: AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01 preserves the temporary destination-plane +2 aligned-recipient benefit while parent is live; this is spell metadata, not intrinsic plane alignment/cosmology.
currentIntegration.blockers: Actual accepted Dimensional Anchor tests the traveler transition endpoints, not portal formation. Other exact voluntary/teleport predicates use their own text. Closing the portal grants no free return; travelers remain where they actually are.
currentIntegration.durations: Divination6: concentration up to60 elapsed seconds. Conjuration8: concentration up to600 elapsed seconds. Each has its own absolute deadline from successful establishment; no shared 60-second portal deadline.

Divination6.formation: NEW fixed30foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within60feet and caster line of effect; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. The chosen center must be on the caster's actual current plane. Its insight benefit reaches eligible creatures with a body portion in the sphere and center-to-body line of effect, including the caster if eligible. It is a nonphysical magical zone, not illumination, cover, a wall or a new perception sense. It does not move with the caster.
Divination6.events: Check actual current plane, geometry, line of effect and effective alignment when each attack/save/task roll event is created. Entering/leaving, changing alignment or losing local eligibility changes future roll eligibility without a free new roll, spell cast or Action. No entry pulse, charge reserve, duration gift or lasting buff is acquired. Extra turns can contain genuine eligible rolls but create no special bonus budget. Partial local suppression removes only the affected current benefit; its clock and parent concentration continue.
Divination6.ending: Ordinary expiry, concentration ending, replacement or an actual eligible whole-source removal ends the zone. It has one rank6 parent record, not a list of separately cast spells. A fixed zone with no independent creature-target branch is ineligible for Xi's creature-branch ending. It gives no distant roll readout or retroactive revision of a completed roll.

Conjuration8.destinationAndSourceChoice: NEW full portal operation, not an insight zone substituted for travel. Choose an actually different plane and a specific destination place whose real physical layout the caster has personally perceived, either by visiting or through a source-authorized ordinary visual view such as Planar Window. A mere map name, secondhand direction, imagined ideal, omen or invented cosmology is insufficient to locate an endpoint. The Director records genuine stable origin/destination plane identities privately; distinct labels alone cannot pass the different-plane condition. Choose exact two opening faces and arrival spaces before commitment. Unknown or changed real destination conditions are resolved after paid commitment with no diagnostic report or substitute plane.
Conjuration8.newEmpowermentInterpretation: NEW consequential interpretation for joint review: the spell temporarily makes the selected destination plane empower creatures matching the cast's snapshotted pair, rather than requiring or asserting that the plane is eternally aligned. While this Nexus operates, its +2 insight benefit applies to every actually eligible creature physically on that destination plane, including preexisting inhabitants and enemies, whenever a qualifying roll occurs. This is deliberately plane-wide to retain the full destination-empowerment promise; it is not reduced to a receiving-pad buff. Evaluate it on actual roll events, without scanning or revealing a population. This temporary magical effect establishes no permanent planar affinity, creation history, soul jurisdiction, objective Wheel mapping, rest rule or moral allegiance. The scope and interpretation are NEW and unadopted, requiring explicit GPT review and later balance assessment.
Conjuration8.openings: NEW concentration up to600elapsed seconds. Form two fixed, visible vertical rectangular openings, each10feet wide and15feet high, linked face-to-face with a recorded neutral orientation. The whole origin opening and its five-foot-deep receiving clearance must be within120feet and caster line of effect. The remote opening/receiving clearance use the exact known destination layout rather than imaginary cross-plane line of effect. Both openings initially need actual unoccupied clear physical aperture volume and a front-side receiving region at least10feet wide,15feet high and5feet deep. A larger traveler needs additional actual receiving clearance at transit. An unsupported but otherwise empty fitting destination is permitted; the spell creates no floor, flight, breathing protection or environmental immunity. A traveler arriving without real support immediately follows its actual Falling/other movement rules. A hidden failure prevents the complete portal pair and empowerment after costs are committed. The spell creates no body in the gap and no third intermediate transit plane.
Conjuration8.transit: While both mouths are operative, a whole actual body may cross by spending five feet of available real movement from an adjacent reachable side; the body and its carried noncreature gear must fit the opening and legal receiving space. Ordinary physically permitted squeezing can apply if it truly allows that whole body through, without automatic resizing. Actual independent forced movement can carry a body through if that movement reaches/crosses the opening and all its own permissions remain legal; the Nexus itself compels nothing and grants no free movement. Separate riders/passengers/carried creatures remain separate bodies. A genuinely inseparable group declared by its actual transport situation is one atomic transaction and every body must fit and satisfy its own blockers. Otherwise bodies cross in a fixed actual event order and occupancy can stop later travelers. Real independent objects/projectiles can cross if they fit and possess actual movement/force. No remote stock is duplicated or pulled through merely by opening the gate. NEW receiving placement: before a particular transit commits, declare the receiving whole-body footprint/pose on the exit's front side, with the nearest edge of that footprint no more than5feet from the exit plane and every body point on the receiving side. It must be a real perceived or personally known location through the actual opening view, fit the current whole body/group and obey the declared exit orientation; it is not a remote retarget beyond the receiving space. Hidden/intervening occupancy is checked after a valid commitment and can defeat that paid movement without a substitute. All bodies retain their actual anatomy, dimensions, load and gear; no slot is reserved against other travelers. The five-foot minimum setup clearance alone does not prove that a Large or larger body fits.
Conjuration8.rangeSightAndAttacks: The open gateway transmits ordinary light and sound along the real unobstructed route through its two apertures. This is a view of the actual destination, not a remote caster body or origin substitution. NEW a genuinely physical nonspell projectile or thrust may pass through the opening with its own legal attack, visibility and remaining range: measure the actual route to the entrance plus from the exit, with zero additional path length for the paired mouth transition. The real attack retains its dealer/root, defenses and event identity. This includes a physical weapon with separately legal magical enhancement; it does not turn its attack into a second cast. A spell or other effect with an actual same-plane targeting/origin restriction keeps it; the gateway does not waive components, concentration, source-origin, target-type or planar limits or authorize casting from the remote mouth. An effect needs its own genuine authority for any nonphysical cross-plane delivery.
Conjuration8.preventionAndFailure: Test each actual transported body's origin and destination against applicable teleport/planar-transition prevention, including Dimensional Anchor, and the actual distinction between voluntary and involuntary travel in the preventing source. This operation is a planar transition and teleportation for these NEW Nexus transit rules; no imaginary intervening-world path is tested. A known invalid transit is not begun. If an obstacle/blocker becomes effective after a valid movement commitment, that transaction stays wholly at its actual origin with already-spent movement/resources retained; no nearest-safe relocation, new destination, partial body or retry occurs. Obstruction of a mouth can block a current transit without ending the entire spell. The gateway grants no universal ward bypass; ordinary Banishment's special terminal closure is unrelated to voluntary Nexus transit.
Conjuration8.suppressionAndClosure: Local suppression intersecting an opening makes that mouth unavailable for transit while the original clock continues. Local suppression at a beneficiary suspends only that creature's current insight expression. Suppression of the caster alone does not automatically end an already established concentration unless its actual source says so. An effect expressly suppressing the entire Nexus suspends both mouths and empowerment within its actual scope. Nothing queues missed moves or bonuses. On expiry, concentration ending, replacement or eligible parent removal, both mouths and all Nexus insight benefits end. Every completed traveler/object remains at its actual current location; there is no automatic return journey, refund or rescue. A transit resolves atomically before or after a closing event under actual event order, never half inside a severed body. If an endpoint's actual containing place ceases to exist, this Nexus ends rather than inventing a location to hold it. Existing source-specific mandatory body settlement remains that other source's responsibility.
Conjuration8.removalAndCustody: Both mouths are addressable manifestations of the same rank8 parent for an actually eligible dispel; ending the parent at either operative mouth ends both and the empowerment. It does not end an independent other Nexus. Plane-wide empowerment is one continuous zone-like effect with no independent creature-target branch, so Xi cannot end the whole plane effect by targeting an arbitrary beneficiary. Ordinary actually applicable narrow suppression/removal sources retain their own scope. All real cargo, bodies, personal custody, permits and institutional consequences remain real on the side where they are. Neither an unseen native population nor private plane facts are reported by the benefit.

This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: DE4-RNG-05
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: DE4-PRESENTATION-06
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only source relationships expressly covered by this exact DE4 authority; no global extension, automatic acquisition or cosmological settlement.
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve both printed placements/access records. The Conjuration source promises 24-hour service; Universal Instantaneous remains establishment metadata. NEW reconciliation: successful binding establishment is instantaneous and creates a nonconcentration service record lasting 86,400 elapsed seconds.

Target one perceived active creature within60/LoE whose current body has explicit operational extraplanar evidence under AC5-PLANAR-META-01: exact current source marks it extraplanar relative to current plane, or committed travel/source provenance proves arrival/creation from a different actual planeKey. Type/outsider/Elemental/summoned labels, Wheel names and supposed native/soul origin are insufficient. Unknown evidence can defeat a paid cast without disclosure.

NEW save: CHA vs actual spell DC; willing target may elect failure. On failure require/spend the shared hard-control allowance. Success creates no service record. Failure creates one live binder→target record until t+86,400 seconds, target death/body-source ending, eligible removal/dispel or replacement of that same binder→target record. It never extends the target’s own source life.

Use AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03. One pending order maximum per binder→target record. Issuance requires same-plane command-intent and the real Bonus Action/6-second order cadence. A pending order binds the next regular target behavior opportunity after issue and expires at the end of that opportunity whether obeyed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. A later valid same-Binding order replaces the prior pending order. Plane separation blocks new issuance but does not erase an already-heard pending order. Suppression at execution makes the order ineffective and expired; the 24-hour clock continues.

Orders may require ordinary movement, basic Attack, Dodge, Disengage, Help, Interact or an at-will action the creature genuinely possesses. They cannot compel RP/spells, charges, recharge/per-rest abilities, consumables/special expendables, permanent property transfer, protected secrets, knowingly binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal routes. Orders arbitrate through accepted Compelled Budget Arbitration and never create another Action/turn/Reaction/Bonus Action/resource.

For companions, the owner’s exact command/offense gate remains prerequisite. Binding cannot manufacture that gate. If an owner legally opens one companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order conflicts only on target selection, priority/arbitration constrains that one available action; no second attack exists. If no source-gated action becomes available in the order’s execution opportunity, it expires.

Finite summon concentration/expiry/replacement/0HP remain real. Lesser Antimagic suppresses local compulsion expression on an intersecting target without pausing the service clock.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

AC6-PRICE-01.status: NEW AC6 bridge using accepted AC5 pricing order; does not alter AC5.
AC6-PRICE-01.rule: For an ordinary AC6 spell, start from its actual base spell RP price (rank6 generally 13; Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is 21). Apply accepted Resonance Nexus ordinary -2 spell-price reduction first when genuinely eligible, then mandatory Resonance Dampening Field +2 if applicable, then final Resonance Influence Ease/Strain. A discount never changes generating rank. Resonance Forge cycle 5 RP is protected conversion principal and is not a spell price or subject to these modifiers.

AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.status: NEW per-card dealer/root mapping constrained by accepted Null/damage-root rules.
AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.rule: Forbiddance: caster is dealer at each new field exposure root. Chain Arc: caster is dealer and one shared selection/damage event still creates recipient-specific damage roots using that caster state at root creation. Skybrand: effect has no creature identity; caster is dealer separately for each attack root. Greater Air Pet, Faction Army soldier and Greater Planar Ally are their own creature dealers for their own attacks/auras. Pure damage transfer preserves the original root flag; genuinely new reflected damage follows its source.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.
AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.rule: While the original summon source exists, Greater Air Pet and each Faction Army soldier body count as an active creature and living ally for otherwise legal HP-healing. This grants no natural biology, soul/native origin, resurrection, disease/curse treatment or generic summon healing. A genuine heal above 0 restores the same NullDisabled body without refreshing source duration or command history. Greater Planar Ally uses GA-HEAL-01 instead.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

sourceRefs.role: accepted Lesser Antimagic local intersection and same-family exception
accepted AC5 scoped body-intersection convention; AC6 extension is new

AC6-COMPANION-01.rule: All actual commanded companions/devices of one owner share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round unless a source explicitly overrides it. Commands occur during the owner regular turn, require actual channel/range/perception/LoE as printed, and execute in the attached phase after the whole owner turn. Extra turns do not reset the ledger. A newly created asset may receive an otherwise available command that round, but creation gives no free attack.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. Use a fair physical die with equal face mapping when practical; otherwise use an exact uniform N-entry draw. A legal reroll such as Fate Coin replaces that one original selection result against the unchanged candidate array and must use the replacement. Hidden Director-only draws remain hidden; a player who cannot perceive the die/event cannot spend Fate Coin. Once a successor is committed, later immunity, death, movement or lawful removal does not redraw earlier/later committed successors.

AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.status: Current negative interoperability conclusion; no new dispel permission created.
AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.rule: Resonance Seal protection cannot currently be selectively suppressed and then dispelled through the same accepted Lesser Antimagic/Greater Dispel transaction. Accepted Greater Dispel captures immutable termination operations; only the operation targeting the suppressing Antimagic field ignores that same field. Operations targeting Seal/parent at suppressed loci are suppressed and are not rescanned after field removal. Wizard class Dispel is a rank3 spell and is itself suppressed when its application locus is suppressed. An actual future/selective source could change this only through its exact text.

AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.status: NEW scoped Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 classification only.
AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.rule: Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 gateway crossings are both planar transitions and teleportation for predicates that expressly reference either. This is source-specific and does not change accepted AC5 Alignment Portal, which remains planar/extradimensional and non-teleport. Voluntary crossing therefore interacts with No Escape, Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes according to each exact predicate; forced movement remains governed by the exact voluntary/benefit wording.

AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.status: NEW bounded Nexus Conjuration8 benefit; no plane ontology claim.
AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.rule: While the Nexus parent remains live, an aligned creature physically present on the designated destination plane may receive the source-specific temporary +2 Nexus benefit at the events the Nexus procedure states. This does not make that plane intrinsically aligned, identify Wheel cosmology, infer soul/native origin, or grant the bonus after parent ending. Eligibility uses current effective alignment under accepted overlay ordering.

AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.status: NEW Resonance Forge conversion interface using Forge revision02.
AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.rule: After a legal Forge cast, each complete cycle costs exactly 5 actual RP from one capable present participant plus 10 uninterrupted actual active minutes by the required workers and credits up to 60 adjusted manufacturing minutes in the current source work phase. The 5 RP is protected conversion principal, not an ordinary spell price. Interrupted cycles spend RP/time but give no cycle credit. A completed cycle does not independently stabilize an unfinished phase; source phase boundaries control stabilized work. Ordinary reviewed crafting XP/first-success/triviality remain in force.

AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.status: NEW family guard for the two Alignment Nexus modes.
AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.rule: One Alignment Nexus parent application per caster. Divination6 and Conjuration8 are distinct operations of one source identity; successful replacement ends the previous parent after normal commitment. Each event receives at most one Nexus bonus from this spell family even if multiple geometric/plane predicates might otherwise overlap.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.status: NEW AC6 scoped completion chosen for coherence with accepted AC5 same-body paused summons.
AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.rule: Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. The same body, identity, HP, Null state, deadline, carried real cargo and source parent remain; manifestation is suppressed, Speed becomes 0 and it cannot act, command, attack, provide intrinsic attacks/traits or satisfy physical-service permissions from the suppressed source. All real clocks continue. If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. When suppression ends before source ending, the same body resumes at the same legal position/state; no missed action/command is replayed.

AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.classification: NEW current-authority promotion/clock clarification for Alignment Nexus only
AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.rule: The full Divination6 and Conjuration8 procedures stored historically in completePriorDraftRecord.modes are promoted into current procedure. Divination6 maximum concentration is60 elapsed seconds; Conjuration8 maximum concentration is600 elapsed seconds. This changes no source/access placement.

AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.classification: NEW AC6-specific physical consequence of full suppression
AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.rule: When AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 fully suppresses Greater Air Pet, its intrinsic fly/hover expression is suppressed. If unsupported, ordinary Falling begins under the existing Falling bridge on the same preserved body. NullDisabled0 alone does not suppress Hover.

AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05.classification: NEW source-specific Chain Arc successor geometry; proposed for joint review, not a global range amendment
rule: Use the actual occupied body volumes in the pre-damage snapshot for every size, including Medium, Large and the caster. A successor is in local range only if one point on the previous body and one point on the candidate body are at most30feet apart AND the straight segment connecting that same pair has actual clear line of effect on the same actual plane. Do not combine the distance of a blocked pair with the line of effect of a different out-of-range pair. Do not mix center measurements for smaller creatures with nearest-body measurements for larger ones.

Include each unvisited qualifying actual creature identity exactly once, including allies, unseen bodies and the caster. Exclude already visited identities, objects, corpses and images. Stable preexisting identity order precedes each fair draw. This is only the successor test: the initial declared target still needs its actual60foot range, caster perception and line of effect.

Bodies have extent. The60foot initial range and five30foot jumps bound their respective targeting gaps, not a universal center-to-center distance to the last body. No arbitrary remote endpoint or unprinted conductive path is added.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_local05PreviousCu.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
